data.narrative_summary: A systemic breach of the core banking platform was detected involving unauthorized administrative access via compromised service account credentials (svc_acct_mgmt). The attacker conducted bulk account enumeration and balance queries, indicating intent to initiate mass fraudulent wire transfers. Immediate containment actions included freezing the primary compromised account (ACC-10042), recalling a fraudulent wire (WIRE-88765), and initiating a chargeback for an unauthorized transaction (TXN-44321). The incident was contained before mass exploitation, but the method indicates a critical vulnerability in privileged access management. All required customer and regulatory notifications have been initiated.

data.narrative_summary: Rogue employee with privileged access to the wire transfer gateway account initiated three unauthorized SWIFT transfers totaling $2.1M to offshore accounts in the Cayman Islands. Immediate freeze of the wire-gw account was executed to prevent further fraudulent activity. Wire recall requests (RCL-2026-01001, RCL-2026-01002, RCL-2026-01003) were issued with immediate urgency; beneficiary banks have been notified and funds are under hold request. Law enforcement has been referred. This incident constitutes a material insider abuse event requiring SAR filing under BSA/AML regulations.
